subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-35 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) opening Braxton's section on dis-unification: 'the most basic resultant that has developed through information compression has been the multi-levels of dis-unification between people (regardless of nationality or affinity nature) — and as a result, non-functionalism.' (C)VT-U-PT (the concept of vibrational universe particulars) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what vibrational-universe-particulars produces when crossed with composite-continuance — under conditions where dis-unification has produced non-functionalism. PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) branches from the main line and carries HI-P (high purpose). MT-INFO (multi-information) also branches from the main line and carries two chains: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) to COS-P (cosmic particulars) to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) to MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) to PRI-INFO (principle information).
